what.text: This page follows refugees from Honduras living in Mexico, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 66685 Honduran refugees in Mexico, 70.6% of all refugees from Honduras.
Mexico is the largest host of Honduran refugees, followed by the United States, Spain and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Honduras, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1986 at 100 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 72914, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mexico.
These are year-end totals for Mexico only, reported to UNHCR.
